title: SCÈNE BACCHIQUE AU MINOTAURE (B. 192; G/B 351; S.V. 85)

events.n: Vollard gave Picasso his first one-man show
events.q: The relationship between Picasso and art dealer, Ambroise Vollard began in Paris in 1901, when Vollard gave the artist his first one-man show.

events.n: the suite began early in 1934, in exchange for a Renoir and a Cézanne
events.q: The Suite Vollard, one of the greatest print projects of the 20th century, began early in 1934, when Picasso wanted to buy a Renoir and a Cézanne from Vollard. They agreed to exchange a body of the artist’s works on copper for the two paintings.
